picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level one-time wealth tax would test how far governments can tax extreme wealth and whether capital and residents leave.

picks.question: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
picks.why: Whether the Fed holds steady signals how policymakers are weighing inflation against growth, which shapes borrowing costs economy-wide.

picks.question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.5% for the year ending in November 2026?
picks.why: Inflation persistently above 3.5% would erode real wages and constrain the Fed's room to cut rates.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and shipping costs elevated worldwide.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership at the AI frontier shapes where investment, talent and productivity gains concentrate across the technology sector.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a Millennium Prize problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning with broad implications for research productivity.
